text.arabic_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

words.gloss_range: corrective or contrastive discourse particle; here it redirects the prior oath frame into diagnosis of the response
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) does not simply continue the oath opening. It makes the ayah begin with a corrective pivot: the solemn oath of 50:1 remains in the background, but the foreground shifts to diagnosing human astonishment. Its independent, clipped form lets the correction stand before the reaction report starts.

topics.headline: post-oath corrective pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah opens by redirecting the suspended oath of 50:1 into a confrontation with human astonishment.
topics.reason: The particle opens the ayah and attachment evidence treats it as introducing the main assertion, so the CRITICAL claim that it redirects the oath boundary is locally coherent.

topics.headline: independent clipped interruption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction is audible and visible as its own discourse act before the verb arrives.
topics.reason: The word is an independent particle, not a prefix on the following verb, so the formal payoff survives without needing lexical root support.

words.gloss_range: they wondered or were astonished; locally a completed collective incredulous reaction whose cause is supplied by the following content clause
words.root_gloss_range: wonder at what departs from expectation, with possible awe, admiration, incredulity, self-admiration, and related adjective branches; the local context selects hostile incredulity
words.prose: {{ar:عَجِبُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ʿajibū}}) makes astonishment the first lexical event after the correction. The perfect plural form presents a settled group reaction before the speakers are named, and the following content clause supplies what they found astonishing. The root {{ar:ع ج ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-j-b}}) still carries a broader wonder range, but the later quoted verdict narrows it into incredulity. The same root then returns at the close, so their inner reaction is projected back as the final label. The opening formula also has a close parallel in 38:4 and anticipates the creation-capacity challenge at 50:15.

topics.headline: settled plural reaction before naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the group reaction before the group is explicitly named, making astonishment the ayah's opening human action.
topics.reason: The finite perfect verb is third masculine plural with a pro-dropped subject, and the later explicit subject supplies the referent.

topics.headline: cause supplied by following clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader moves immediately from reaction into its cause because the object is supplied by the following arrival clause rather than by a separate noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following clause as the content complement, matching the CRITICAL claim of compressed cause.

topics.headline: broader wonder narrowed by denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not reduce the root to neutral amazement; the ayah lets wonder sound open at first and then exposes it as hostile incredulity.
topics.reason: The root's broader wonder range is real, but the named speakers and final verdict select the negative side locally.

topics.headline: opening reaction returns as closing label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed by wonder and also hears the opening as part of a polemical pattern visible in 38:4 and answered later at 50:15.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply both the identical opening formula in 38:4 and the same-ayah root reprise; both survive as structural payoffs.

words.gloss_range: clause-introducing particle; here nominalizes the completed arrival clause as the content of astonishment
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) is the tight hinge between astonishment and its explanation. Because it precedes a perfect arrival verb, it works here as a clause-maker for a completed fact, not as a future subjunctive trigger. The short particle lets the ayah move quickly from reaction to the event that caused it.

topics.headline: arrival clause made the object of wonder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the arrival itself, not a separate unnamed object, is syntactically what they find astonishing.
topics.reason: The attachment profile identifies the following clause as the content complement of the wonder verb.

topics.headline: completed fact rather than projected future
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scandal is presented as an accomplished arrival, not a future possibility.
topics.reason: The following verb is perfect, so the particle's local function is nominalizing rather than future-subjunctive.

topics.headline: narrow hinge from reaction to cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the grammar compress the transition instead of pausing between emotion and explanation.
topics.reason: The particle is a short independent word directly between the reaction verb and the arrival verb.

words.gloss_range: came to them; locally concrete completed arrival directed at the audience by the attached object pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arrival, presence, and related occurrence senses; the local subject and object suffix select personal arrival rather than abstract happening
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَهُم}} ({{tr:jāʾahum}}) turns the cause of wonder into an accomplished encounter. The root {{ar:ج ي أ}} ({{tr:j-y-ʾ}}) can cover coming or occurrence, but the singular warner as subject and the attached plural object select directed arrival: the warner came to them. The repeated pronoun chain makes the same people both recipients of the coming and, in the next phrase, the community from whom the warner is drawn. The word also begins an arrival motif that the surah later reuses at 50:5, 50:19, 50:21, and 50:33, and it participates in warning-arrival rejection scenes such as 38:4, 7:63, and 7:69.

topics.headline: arrival to them, not abstract occurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the arrival as a completed personal encounter that reaches the audience directly.
topics.reason: The broad arrival root lacks V4 branch detail in this bundle, but local grammar selects a personal arrival with the warner as subject and the suffix as object.

topics.headline: same group as target and source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scandal is intensified because the audience is both the target of the warning and the community from which the warner comes.
topics.reason: The object suffix here and the following source suffix have the same plural referent, and attachment evidence marks the later phrase as qualifying the warner.

topics.headline: arrival links warning and later surah movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this coming as the hinge between warning's presence and denial speech, with the motif recurring later in the surah and in rejection scenes such as 38:4, 7:63, and 7:69.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references and cross-surah warning-arrival scenes, so the motif can survive without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: a warner; locally an indefinite nominative active participle naming the arriving agent and warning role
words.root_gloss_range: warning that awakens caution, with related vow and obligation branches; local Form IV active participle selects warning-agent force while vow undertone remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:مُّنذِرٌۭ}} ({{tr:mundhirun}}) supplies the arriving agent. It is not a new finite warning action but an active-participle identity: the one who has come is characterized as a warning agent. The root {{ar:ن ذ ر}} ({{tr:n-dh-r}}) includes warning and vow or obligation fields; the local Form IV participle selects alerting others to danger while allowing a faint sense of binding seriousness. Its indefiniteness keeps the role general enough to fit a recurrent internal-warner formula, including 10:2, 38:4, 46:21, and the later rejection pattern at 50:12-14.

topics.headline: participle names the arriving agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the arrival is embodied in a role-bearing person, not merely in an abstract warning event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the participle the nominative subject of the arrival verb, and its noun form names a role rather than a fresh finite action.

topics.headline: warning selected from vow-warning field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears warning as danger-alert with seriousness and obligation pressure, while the local role remains warner rather than vow-maker.
topics.reason: V4 supports both warning and vow branches, but the Form IV active participle in this clause selects the warning-agent branch.

topics.headline: Form IV active participle as active alerter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form makes the figure an active alerter, not just someone associated with warning in a loose way.
topics.reason: The QAC-compatible tag identifies an active participle and the row's Form IV contrast is compatible with the local surface.

topics.headline: internal warner in rejection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the obstacle is not foreignness but nearness: warning comes through someone from within the community.
topics.reason: The following source phrase qualifies this participle, and the CRITICAL rows give concrete formula parallels.

words.gloss_range: from among them or from them; locally marks the warner's source group with the same plural audience pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) is the pivot of the scandal. The preposition and suffix qualify the warner as coming from the same group that received the arrival, so the objection is not that the messenger is remote but that warning has appeared from within. The phrase keeps source, partitive membership, and kind-specifying force close together, while local attachment makes the source-community reading govern.

topics.headline: same audience as source community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the warner's nearness to the audience is the point that sharpens their astonishment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as the source group qualifying the warner, and it shares the antecedent of the earlier object suffix.

topics.headline: source and partitive senses kept local
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase can imply both origin and membership, while the local grammar ties it to the warner's identity.
topics.reason: The preposition has a broader range, but the local attachment to the warner narrows the operative reading to source or internal membership.

topics.headline: one word compresses origin and antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels how a very small word seals the relation between the warning agent and the audience.
topics.reason: The preposition plus suffix is one compact unit, and its antecedent is licensed by the surrounding pronoun chain.

words.gloss_range: consequential or sequential conjunction; here pivots from astonishment over arrival into the reported verdict
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the saying follow as consequence, not as an unrelated quotation. It keeps sequence and causality together: they are astonished that a warner has come from among them, and so the reported speech breaks out. Its fusion to the following speech verb makes the transition into quotation immediate.

topics.headline: speech follows as consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the quote as the effect of astonishment, not as a disconnected report.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence sequences the saying after the amazement, supporting both sequential and causal force.

topics.headline: fused prefix makes immediate transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how tightly the narrative turns from reaction report to speech frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction is represented as a prefix on the following verb in the ayah sequence, making the transition formally tight.

words.gloss_range: he said; locally a perfect speech-frame verb introducing the disbelievers' quoted verdict
words.root_gloss_range: uttered speech, saying, report, opinion, doctrine, inner saying, and other speech-related branches; local grammar selects articulated reported speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) externalizes the inward astonishment as quoted speech. The root {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) is broad and common, but here the perfect Form I verb opens a direct-speech scope, with the plural subject named after the singular verb. That makes the group speak as one collective voice. Form I reports the verdict directly without making the morphology about fabrication or causing someone else to speak. The saying also seeds a same-surah speech thread that later includes 50:18, 50:23, 50:27, 50:28, and 50:29, and it belongs to rejection-speech formulas visible at 38:4 and 10:2.

topics.headline: quoted verdict opened
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reaction become an accountable quotation rather than remaining an internal feeling.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final nominal sentence as the quoted complement governed by this verb.

topics.headline: singular verb before plural speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a plural class is made to utter one unified verdict.
topics.reason: The verb is masculine singular and the explicit plural subject follows, a normal Arabic pattern that collectivizes the speech act.

topics.headline: broad saying narrowed to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the speech as an articulated stance or verdict, not mere noise, perception, or neutral reporting.
topics.reason: V4 gives many saying-related branches, but the local quoted complement selects articulated direct speech and opinion-pronouncement.

topics.headline: first quote seeds later speech accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first disbelieving saying as the start of a surah pattern where speech is recorded, answered, and judged, while also echoing rejection-speech formulas at 38:4 and 10:2.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah speech references and formula links with 38:4 and 10:2.

words.gloss_range: the disbelievers or deniers; locally a definite active-participle plural naming the class that utters the verdict
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, rejecting truth, ingratitude, disavowal, farmer-covering, expiation, and other covering-derived branches; local speaker label selects rejecting truth while retaining the covering image
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirūna}}) finally names the group whose reaction has been carried by verb endings and pronouns. The root {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) has many covering-derived branches, but the definite active participle here selects a rejecting class: their covering of truth is enacted as speech. The label is not a one-off action report; it identifies the speakers and sets up the later sharpening at 50:5 and the intensified judgment language at 50:24. It also fits denial-speech patterns where astonishment is voiced by rejecters, including 38:4 and 10:2.

topics.headline: named rejecting class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speakers classified by an identity of rejection, not merely reported as people who happened to say something.
topics.reason: The word is a definite active-participle plural and attachment evidence makes it the explicit subject of the saying verb.

topics.headline: covering image narrowed to denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears disbelief as an act of covering or misclassifying disclosed truth, while unrelated root branches stay inactive.
topics.reason: V4 shows many covering-derived branches, but the local active-participle speaker label selects rejection of truth and not farmer, expiation, or object branches.

topics.headline: denial enacted through speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the quoted verdict itself as the way their covering response becomes visible, including a broader denial-speech pattern seen at 38:4 and 10:2.
topics.reason: The word is the subject of the speech frame, and the co-occurrence rows connect rejection with saying and warning.

topics.headline: speaker label later sharpened
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the initial label develop into explicit denial of the truth and later intensified judgment within the same surah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, so the thread is retained as a local provenance payoff.

words.gloss_range: this; proximal demonstrative opening the quoted nominal verdict, pointing to the encountered event and possibly forward to the next objection
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) opens the quotation by pointing before naming. It functions as the subject of the verbless verdict, so the speakers reduce the encountered matter by deixis and classification rather than by argument. The near demonstrative makes the thing treated as present, not remote rumor, while the quote can also press forward into the resurrection objection of 50:3. As the quote's soft deictic onset, it lets the pointing gesture precede the heavier evaluative close.

topics.headline: near demonstrative starts the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the quote begin as a pointing act that treats the object as present and inspectable.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the demonstrative as the subject of the quoted nominal sentence.

topics.headline: points back and presses forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both the just-mentioned warner-arrival and the next ayah's resurrection objection in view without forcing a single explicit noun referent.
topics.reason: The bundle warns to preserve ambiguity: the demonstrative points to the immediately expressed content and may create forward pressure, but it does not name a specific noun inside the quote.

topics.headline: dismissal by pointing and classifying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers do not engage the message directly; they point at it and reduce it into a category.
topics.reason: The demonstrative begins a quoted nominal classification, supporting the CRITICAL claim that the verdict rejects indirectly.

topics.headline: soft deictic opening before judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quoted verdict begin with a pointing gesture before the heavier evaluative close arrives.
topics.reason: The row's sound observation remains a small but coherent payoff because the demonstrative is the first word of the quote.

words.gloss_range: a thing; locally an indefinite predicate noun that de-identifies the referent before the adjective evaluates it
words.root_gloss_range: thingness as what can be known, reported, or indicated, with will or volition branches and other remote lexical branches; local noun selects broad thingness with only secondary will pressure
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٌ}} ({{tr:shayʾun}}) is the quoted predicate that turns the referent into an unnamed category. The root {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) can carry universal thingness and a will-related background, but the local indefinite noun primarily de-identifies: instead of naming the warner, revelation, or resurrection claim, the speakers call it a thing. Its singular form compresses event, message, and claim into one dismissible item, and the following adjective attaches to that vague noun before delivering the judgment. The thing-plus-wonder bundle also has wider anomaly-language parallels at 38:5, 33:52, 9:25, and 11:72, while same-surah thingness reappears in a different evaluative setting at 50:35.

topics.headline: unnamed thing as predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the speakers avoid naming what has come and instead classify it as an unspecified thing.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the predicate of the demonstrative, and its indefinite form supports the de-identifying payoff.

topics.headline: broad noun compresses multiple pressures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the warner-arrival, message, and resurrection objection available as one compressed object of dismissal.
topics.reason: The noun's universal range and singular number support broad reference, while the quote's demonstrative context limits it to the contested content.

topics.headline: will pressure behind thingness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paradox that their vague label still leaves the referent as a thing within the field of what is willed or brought about.
topics.reason: V4 supports will-related branches, but the local surface is the noun of thingness, so volition remains background pressure rather than the selected sense.

topics.headline: middle noun mediates judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the quote's structure reduce first and evaluate second: pointing, thingness, then strangeness.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence binds the final adjective to this noun, making the middle predicate the platform for the judgment.

topics.headline: local phrase belongs to wider thingness field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase as more than generic vocabulary: the noun participates in a constrained evaluative bundle and a later same-surah contrast at 50:35.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete phrase and recurrence evidence, including 38:5, 33:52, 9:25, 11:72, and 50:35.

words.gloss_range: strange, wondrous, or wonder-causing; locally a negative evaluative adjective modifying the indefinite thing
words.root_gloss_range: wonder at unfamiliarity, causing wonder, pleasing impressiveness, self-admiration, and other branches; local adjective selects the negative anomaly label in reported denial speech
words.prose: {{ar:عَجِيبٌ}} ({{tr:ʿajībun}}) is the final evaluative word of the quote and of the ayah. The root {{ar:ع ج ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-j-b}}) can name wonder more broadly, but the disbelieving speech frame narrows the adjective into a negative anomaly label. Because it modifies the indefinite thing, their subjective astonishment is made to sound like an inherent quality of the referent, and its matching indefinite ending binds it audibly to that vague noun. The local adjective stops short of the stronger intensive form used at 38:5. The ending also returns the root that opened the ayah, so the verdict exposes itself as their own reaction projected outward, contrasts the glory named in 50:1, and presses forward into the resurrection objection of 50:3.

topics.headline: final adjective modifies vague noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that strangeness is grammatically attached to the vague noun, not floated as a separate claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the adjective of the indefinite predicate noun.

topics.headline: subjective wonder made object-quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers turn their own incredulity into a property supposedly inherent in the message.
topics.reason: The root can be positive or neutral wonder, but the speaker label and dismissive quote select negative strangeness.

topics.headline: qualitative adjective with paired ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the indefinite adjective bind acoustically and grammatically to the indefinite thing as one dismissive phrase.
topics.reason: The adjective shares the noun's indefinite nominative shape, and the qualitative form fits the local modifier role.

topics.headline: inherent quality without stronger intensive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verdict ascribes stable strangeness without using the stronger intensive form found in 38:5.
topics.reason: The intensive alternative belongs to the root family and appears in 38:5, but the local surface is the qualitative adjective.

topics.headline: opening reaction returned as final label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah end where its first lexical verb began, revealing the final verdict as a projection of the opening reaction.
topics.reason: The same root occurs in the opening reaction verb and the final adjective, and the final position makes the reprise the ayah's landing point.

topics.headline: closing verdict points beyond itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing adjective contrast the glory named in 50:1 and press forward into the resurrection objection of 50:3.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give concrete references and the quote scope allows the final adjective to create forward pressure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ع ج ب at words 2 and 11 brackets the arrival of an in-group warner and the quoted classification هذا شيء عجيب.
baseline_models.mechanism: An immediate reaction to the warner is externalized as speech, reduced to a generic reportable thing, and sealed by repeating the reaction as an adjective. The opening and closing wonder thus form a self-confirming act of objectification rather than two independent descriptions.

activation_trace.role: Wonder at what is unfamiliar supplies both the opening reaction and the closing label, creating the enclosing frame.
Actual arrival supplies the event that interrupts the audience before it classifies what happened.
A warning that alerts to danger gives the arriving person a functional purpose that the later generic label suppresses.
Spoken articulation turns private surprise into a public classificatory act.
The maximally general knowable and reportable thing converts a specific warner and warning into an undifferentiated object.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports that they found a human messenger surprising.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a reaction-to-label loop: surprise strips the arriving warning of its function, calls it merely a thing, and then cites that very label as proof of its strangeness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جاءهم ثم فقال الكافرون places the designation كافرون after contact with the warning, not before any exposure to it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival first makes the warning present; covering and truth-blocking then describe an active response to presence. Their circulated saying supplies the verbal cover by replacing the particular warning with the vague expression this thing.

activation_trace.role: Arrival establishes prior contact, making the subsequent cover a reaction rather than simple lack of information.
Literal covering supplies the operative image for hiding what has just become present.
Blocking acknowledged truth specifies the epistemic and volitional function of that cover.
A saying that circulates among people makes the cover social and repeatable rather than merely inward.
Generic thing-language supplies the cover's linguistic surface by withholding the warning's specific claim.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers are a fixed group who happen to voice incredulity.
changed_reading.after: Their disbelief is enacted in real time: what arrives is actively covered by a socially usable generic label.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جاءهم, منذر, and شيء can be linked through branch images of being driven into a matter and alerted to danger.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch chain lets arrival shade into being compelled, while thing-language can carry someone toward an affair and warning makes the stakes urgent. On this reading their wonder registers experienced pressure from a familiar insider, not only surprise at his identity.

activation_trace.role: The derived image of driving or compelling someone toward something supplies pressure within the arrival event.
Carrying someone toward an affair lets the named thing function as a demanded course rather than a neutral object.
Danger-alerting warning supplies the urgency that makes the encounter feel constraining.
The doubled unfamiliarity registers resistance to that experienced pressure at both ends of the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's coming is a neutral motion followed by an unrelated warning.
changed_reading.after: The focus branches provisionally permit a pressure-chain in which arrival confronts them with a consequential matter, making their strange label a resistance response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both ع ج ب and شيء have packet branches of visual approval or inward attraction, while the ayah repeats wonder around the utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hostile classification need not exhaust the affect carried by the repeated wonder. Attraction and visual approval can leak through the disbelieving speech, so the utterance may betray fascination with what it attempts to reject.

activation_trace.role: Finding something pleasing in the eye supplies an admiring undertone to both occurrences of wonder.
The soul's attraction toward a thing makes the object of their statement affectively magnetic as well as strange.
Truth-blocking keeps the attractive undertone in tension with explicit rejection rather than converting the saying into assent.
The spoken utterance is where the mixed affect becomes audible despite the speakers' rejecting stance.

changed_reading.after: The same declaration can hold rejection and involuntary fascination together, with wonder betraying attraction to the warning it marks as alien.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near replay in 50:5 identifies the response to arrival as attributing falsehood to stable truth and gives mixed disorder as its resulting condition. This sharpens the focus label عجيب into the first verbal operation of a denial loop: encounter is covered by classification, and the classifiers lose stable ordering.

activation_trace.role: The unfamiliarity frame supplies the initial and final classification that the later denial-disorder sequence explains.
Blocking truth anchors the changed mechanism in the focus speakers' named stance.
Arrival fixes contact as the event to which both the focus label and the later denial respond.
Attributing a thing or its bearer to falsehood supplies the explicit operation hidden inside the focus's vague strange label.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what is being denied and prevents strangeness from being treated as an objective defect.
Mixture and disorder supply the cognitive outcome of the attempted reclassification.

structural_cues: 50:5 repeats the 50:2 pivot بل and the same arrival-to-them construction before naming denial and disorder.
The focus sequence reaction then speech is extended by 50:5 into denial then a disordered affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated arrival, the truth-falsehood opposition, and ensuing disorder; I infer that the strange label participates in the denial that destabilizes their categories. A live alternative is that disorder merely accompanies denial rather than being produced by the label.

changed_reading.before: Their utterance neutrally describes an inherently strange object.
changed_reading.after: Their utterance is a truth-denying classification whose apparent explanatory certainty generates, or at least exposes, the very disorder it tries to control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following visual field repeatedly presents made beauty and fresh delight. Those cues activate the focus branches in which wonder is visual approval and a thing attracts the soul, allowing the rejecting declaration to carry an involuntary aesthetic acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Visual approval supplies the focus affect that the later beauty vocabulary calibrates.
Attraction of the soul to a thing lets their named object exert a pull despite rejection.
Truth-blocking contains the admiration as conflicted leakage rather than acceptance.
Making beauty visible supplies an ordered object of sight immediately after the denial scene.
Fresh beauty supplies the affective quality that can echo inside the doubled wonder.

structural_cues: 50:6-7 follow the denial scene with an invitation to inspect ordered sky and earth rather than merely assert a proposition.
The focus's doubled affect is close enough to this visual sequence to carry both estrangement and captivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus branches of attraction and subsequent images of visible beauty; I infer tonal leakage from that field into the disbelievers' wonder. The stronger alternative remains hostile incredulity with no admiration intended.

changed_reading.before: Their wonder is emotionally one-directional rejection.
changed_reading.after: Their rejecting speech may also confess that the warning arrests and attracts them, making عجيب an ambivalent rather than emotionally flat label.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch in which a kafir covers seed becomes functional inside the surah's dust-to-growth-to-emergence sequence. Covering the arrived warning can hide it, but the material analogy makes that act resemble burial in a medium from which life emerges and which finally splits open; concealment cannot secure cancellation.

activation_trace.role: The sower's covering of seed supplies the focus-anchored material action that the growth and emergence sequence transforms.
Soil and dust supply the apparent medium of disappearance and the latent bed for the seed analogy.
Plant life coming out of earth supplies the first reversal of covering into visible growth.
Earth revived through water and vegetation turns the growth image into a life-restoration mechanism.
Passage to the outside names emergence as the endpoint of the buried-growth process.
Splitting and opening the earth supplies the final failure of the cover to contain what lies beneath it.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from becoming dust in 50:3, through growth and revived land in 50:7-11, to earth splitting around them in 50:44.
In the focus ayah the covering designation occurs only after the warning has already arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seed-covering, soil, growth, revived land, exit, and splitting; I infer a material analogy between covering the warning and burying viable seed. A live alternative keeps كفر wholly epistemic and treats the vegetation sequence only as evidence for bodily resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Covering is a successful act of hiding or negating the warning.
changed_reading.after: The cover is ironically recoded as burial: it delays visibility but places what is covered inside the surah's repeated mechanism of growth and forced emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The literal covering branch of كفر becomes a perceptual process in 50:22: inattentiveness leaves the matter outside vigilance, an ignorance-cover is removed, and sight becomes penetrating. The focus label عجيب therefore diagnoses occluded perception rather than an inherent defect in the warning.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering anchors the later perceptual veil in the focus speakers' designation.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the counter-function aimed against inattentiveness.
Perceived unfamiliarity becomes the symptom produced while the cover remains in place.
Leaving something outside alert awareness supplies the cognitive condition sustained by the cover.
Lifting a cover supplies the decisive reversal of the focus's covering action.
A cover of ignorance specifies that the obstructing layer is epistemic, not a property of the warned-about reality.
A sharp penetrating edge supplies the transformed sight that can cut through the former occlusion.

structural_cues: 50:22 explicitly moves from prior heedlessness, through removal of a personal cover, to newly sharp sight.
The focus moves in the opposite direction, from arrival into a covering classification, so the two scenes form a reversible perceptual sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, heedlessness, removal, and sharp sight; I infer that the focus speakers' strange judgment is generated by the veil they maintain. A live alternative is that 50:22 describes only eschatological disclosure without diagnosing the earlier utterance's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They reject because the warning objectively appears strange.
changed_reading.after: The warning appears strange because active covering has made their perception inattentive; later disclosure reverses that condition and exposes strangeness as observer-produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus marks the warner as one of them, yet the objection immediately casts return as far. Later nearness repeatedly defeats that distancing: the garden is driven near rather than remaining far, and a raised call comes from a near place. The strange label functions as social and temporal estrangement of what arrives from within their own circle.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies present contact with the warning against which the audience projects distance.
The in-group danger-alert is the socially near source that their strange label alienates.
Distance as the opposite of nearness supplies the audience's explicit verdict on return.
Direct nearness reverses the projected remoteness at the location of the culminating call.
Movement into nearness supplies an eschatological reality that actively closes the distance the audience asserts.
The raised call makes warning publicly audible again, now from the near place that cannot be dismissed as remote.

structural_cues: The focus's منهم makes the messenger socially internal before the audience labels his coming strange.
The progression from a return called far in 50:3 to not-far nearness in 50:31 and a near caller in 50:41 reverses their spatial verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an in-group messenger, an asserted far return, active nearness, and a near call; I infer that strangeness is a distancing strategy applied to an uncomfortably near warning. A live alternative treats these as separate social and eschatological distances without one shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The warning is strange because it comes from an unsuitable familiar person and concerns a remote event.
changed_reading.after: The very familiarity of the messenger exposes the label as manufactured estrangement, while the surah steadily brings the supposedly remote warning into unavoidable nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah blocks the focus-only branch chain from becoming literal coercion: the messenger is not to compel them, but to make the reminder present for a hearer whose own anticipation of danger renders it effective. The pressure in جاءهم منذر is therefore rhetorical and conscience-awakening rather than forced transport into a course.

activation_trace.role: The derived compelling-arrival image supplies the provisional pressure reading that the finale constrains.
Being carried toward an affair extends that provisional chain from arrival into the object they call strange.
Danger-alerting warning preserves real urgency after physical or political compulsion is removed.
A reminder that makes something present again supplies the messenger's authorized noncoercive action.
Overpowering compulsion names precisely the agency negated at the surah's close.
Anticipatory fear supplies the hearer's internal uptake mechanism, replacing externally imposed force.

structural_cues: The final ayah directly juxtaposes negated compulsion with the imperative to remind.
It also returns to what they say, closing the focus utterance while denying the messenger coercive control over its speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus branches of coercive motion, then explicit negation of compulsion and a reminder addressed to one who fears; I infer that the finale regulates how the earlier arrival should be heard. A live alternative limits the negation to enforcement and leaves the derived arrival shade untouched.

changed_reading.before: The warner's coming can be heard as forcing the audience into an imposed matter.
changed_reading.after: The encounter presses without coercing: the messenger presents danger and restores it to attention, while response arises through the hearer's own awakened anticipation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus uses verbal and adjectival wonder, whereas branch B004 names a bodily noun. It remains anchored in the repeated ع ج ب root and is activated by the packet's death, dust, bodily diminution, preservation, creation, and newness sequence. Render it only as form-distant root-play or a material echo, never as a claim that عجبوا or عجيب lexically means tailbone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ع ج ب inventory attached to the root repeated at words 2 and 11 includes the base of the tail between the hips as B004.

activation_trace.role: The bodily base at the rear supplies a latent remnant image beneath the doubled surface sense of wonder.
Loss of life supplies the bodily dissolution problem against which a residual base becomes salient.
Dust supplies the material state into which the body is imagined to pass.
The loss of parts supplies a decomposition process that makes the possibility of a remainder diagnostic.
Guarding and preserving supply continuity across the body's material diminution.
Bringing creation into being supplies reconstruction as the process acting on what death and earth diminish.
New occurrence after a break supplies the temporal bridge from residual continuity to renewed creation.

changed_reading.before: The repeated wonder root only comments on the audience's mental reaction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the doubled wonder can also frame a bodily remainder held between dissolution and renewed creation, so their strange label faintly names the material continuity they deny.

strongest_changes: The strange label became an active denial operation whose apparent certainty produces or exposes disorder.
The covering image became both a reversible perceptual veil and, more experimentally, seed-burial that cannot prevent emergence.
The in-group warner and the surah's repeated nearness recast strangeness as a strategy for distancing what is already close.
The final negation of compulsion revised a focus-only pressure reading into warning that works through reminder and voluntary fear.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let distant material and structural recurrences activate unusually specific focus branches: admiration inside rejection, seed-covering inside resurrection ecology, coercive arrival corrected by the finale, and a tightly contained tailbone-remnant echo under the doubled ع ج ب.
remaining_uncertainties: The attraction reading remains subordinate to the explicit disbelief and later denial, even though the beauty sequence keeps it live.
The seed and tailbone mechanisms are cross-domain or form-distant and should not displace the direct senses of disbelief and wonder.
The arrow from denial to disorder is abductive; the packet also permits disorder as a concurrent condition rather than a produced effect.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wonder becomes a covering response.** The repeated `ع ج ب:B001` marks encounter with the unfamiliar; `ج ي ء:B001` supplies arrival, `ن ذ ر:B001` warning that awakens caution, and `ك ف ر:B003` covering or rejecting truth. The sequence supplies arrival → wonder → verbal rejection; I infer that wonder is converted into a defensive cover rather than inquiry. The final “wondrous thing” therefore echoes and exposes their first reaction as a mechanism of refusal.
2. **Their statement fixes a doctrine, not only an exclamation.** `ق و ل:B013` permits saying as held belief, and `ش ي ء:B001` marks a knowable thing. Coupled with later `لَبْس` and unveiled sight, I infer that they turn a potentially knowable event into a settled doctrine of strangeness. The ayah reads as epistemic closure: a public label arrests investigation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:22 supplied the strongest later correction: once the cover is removed, sight becomes sharply discriminating. This makes the doubled wonder in 50:2 look less like neutral surprise and more like the first layer of a self-installed perceptual cover.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wonder as a self-sealing judgment.** The ayah brackets the event with verbal and adjectival `ع ج ب`; `ع ج ب B001` supplies wonder at an unfamiliar cause, while `ع ج ب B002` supplies self-admiration. The same people first experience wonder and then authorize it in their own saying, while 50:4–7 place knowable preservation and ordered sky/earth before them. The packet supplies that reflexive repetition and the corrective order; I infer that their astonishment is being ratified by their own opinion. The response reads less like innocent puzzlement and more like self-enclosed admiration of one’s judgment.

2. **Denial as infertile covering.** `ك ف ر B001` supplies covering, `ك ف ر B003` truth-rejection, and `ك ف ر B008` the farmer who covers seed. Within the window, the warning arrives, truth arrives again in 50:5, and 50:7 shows earth receiving what is placed in it and producing growth. The packet supplies the two coverings; I infer the contrastive arrow: reception can cover an arrival so that it germinates, whereas the kāfir’s covering arrests it at denial. The unbelievers’ label thus acquires a material mechanism: they bury the warning without allowing its latent yield.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:7 was the decisive later surprise: earth receives placed material and grows a delightful yield, making `ك ف ر B008` expose denial as the non-germinating kind of covering. The ordered sky and earth in 50:6–7 also corrected “wonder” from lack of available cause to a judgment protected by its own repetition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Covered Truth and Tangled Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rejection works by covering what is real and then inhabiting the disorder produced by that concealment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The rejecting mind resembles both a covered object and a garment whose materials have been mixed until its form is hard to distinguish.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Truth Covered and Called False
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A real disclosure arrives, is covered from view, and is actively recast as false.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: covering something `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; concealing or rejecting truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; truth or reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; establishing or showing truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`; accusing or denying as a lie `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rejection is a two-stage operation: the real is first covered and then redescribed as unreal. The lie is therefore not an independent object but a verbal cover laid over an arriving disclosure.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, olağan sayılmayan, benzeri az görülen veya nedeni bilinmeyen bir şey karşısında insanda beliren şaşma halini ve böyle bir şeyin şaşırtıcı diye nitelenmesini birlikte verir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu odağı koruyor; kendini beğenme, güzel bulma ve kuyruk tabanı anlamları bu dalın dışında kalmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem yalın tepki adını hem de belirli niteleme ve kalıp kullanımlarını içerir; kalıba bağlı örnekler yalın anlamın yerine geçirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karışıktır: yalın şaşma ve şaşırtıcı şey çekirdeği korunur, özel söz kalıpları yalnız kendi bağlamında açıklanır.

concept_map.definition: Olağan dışı, benzeri az görülen veya nedeni bilinmeyen bir şey karşısında insanın şaşmasıdır; aynı çekirdek, böyle bir şeyi şaşırtıcı ya da şaşılacak diye nitelemek için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, alışılmamış veya nedeni kavranamayan bir şeye yönelen şaşma halidir.
Şaşmaya yol açan şey, şaşırtıcı, benzeri görülmemiş veya sınırı aşmış diye nitelenebilir.
Bazı söz kalıpları bu şaşırtıcılığı pekiştirmek veya bir öyküyü şaşılacak diye göstermek için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi, hem şaşma halini hem de bu hale yol açan işi veya şeyi kapsar. Ortak anlatımda olağan dışılık, az rastlanırlık, nedeni bilinmezlik ve güçlü şaşırtıcılık aynı çekirdeğin bağımlı yönleri olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın tepkiyi ve bu tepkiyi doğuran şaşırtıcı nesne veya işi birlikte temsil eden en kısa genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Olağan dışı uyarıcıyı ve ona verilen şaşma tepkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işi veya nesneyi şaşma doğuran şey olarak niteleyen bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase frames the sense as warning through communication that frightens and awakens caution. The supplied claim supports that boundary by joining notification, fear-producing content, the person or act of warning, reciprocal warning, and the resulting knowledge and guarded response.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye ya da topluluğa korkulacak bir durumu bildirip onları sakınmaya uyandırma anlamıdır. Uyaran kişi, uyarı olayı, karşılıklı uyarma ve tehlikeyi öğrenip korunmaya geçme kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da topluluğa korkulacak bir durumu haber vererek onları sakınmaya yöneltir.
Aynı çekirdek, uyaran kişi veya uyarı olayının kendisi için adlaşmış kullanımlara taşır.
Topluluk içinde birbirini tehlikeye karşı uyarma, çekirdeğin karşılıklı eylem biçimidir.
Düşmandan haberdar olup hazırlık ve korunmaya geçme, bilginin sakınma sonucunu gösterir.
Ani tehlike habercisi ve ordunun öncü gözcüsü gibi sözler, uyarı çekirdeğine bağlı örneklerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase correctly treats the sense as a person placing a non-obligatory matter on themself as a binding duty. The supplied claim repeatedly frames the act as making something required on oneself, including a vow directed to God or a conditional promise.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisine daha önce zorunlu olmayan bir şeyi gerekli ve bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük yapmasıdır. Bu yükümlülük Tanrı'ya yönelik bir adak, kişinin kendi üzerine aldığı söz veya bir şarta bağlanan vaat olarak gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendi üzerine önceden zorunlu olmayan bir işi bağlayıcı yükümlülük haline getirir.
Yükümlülük Tanrı'ya yöneltilen bir adak ya da kişinin kendi üzerine aldığı bağlayıcı söz olabilir.
Bazı kullanımlarda yükümlülük, belirli bir olay gerçekleşirse yerine getirilecek şartlı söz biçimindedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase frames the sense as a wound that has a required compensatory amount, and the supplied claim supports that by restricting the use to injury payments, named wound cases, and a single wound with an owed amount. This is not the devotional vow branch, even though both can involve something becoming due.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: The branch is restricted to compensation owed for wounds, not a general vow, warning, or ordinary injury description.

lexicalization_scope.note: The mechanical scope keeps the injury-payment lexical unit and the named wound collocation within a restricted legal sense, without generalizing it to every wound or every due payment.

concept_map.definition: Yaralamalar için ödenmesi gereken karşılık ya da bedel anlamıdır. Özellikle belirli yara türleri ve tek bir yaranın ölçülmüş karşılığı gibi hukuki bağlamlarda kullanılır.

Aynı karşılık için bazı hukuk çevrelerinde başka bir teknik ad bulunduğu belirtilir.
Kemiği açığa çıkaran yara için belirli bir pay gibi örnekler, bedelin yara türüne bağlandığını gösterir.

Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: قلقل أي صوت وهو حكاية؛ قلقله قلقلة وقلقالا فتقلقل أي حركه فتحرك واضطرب (sihah)؛ القلقلة والتقلقل قلة الثبوت في المكان؛ يتقلقل في موضعه؛ القلق ألا يستقر الشيء في مكان واحد (tahdhib)؛ تقلقل الشيء إذا اضطرب؛ تقلقل المسمار؛ القلقلة حكاية صوت الحركة (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

lu_002.text: azlık ve yetersizlik; yoksulluk ve düşüklük

lu_003.text: az; az sayıda veya az miktarda

lu_032.text: kendisi de ailesi de tanınmayan adam

lu_016.text: iki büyük küp veya bunların aldığı miktar

lu_026.text: sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi örtme ve görünmez kılma çekirdeğini; zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme, külün toprakla kapanması ve yıldızların güneş ışığında görünmemesi gibi gerçekleşmelerle açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel örtmedir; dinî inkâr, nimeti yadsıma ve günahı giderme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın örtme çekirdeğini korur; zırh, silah, kül ve gök cisimleriyle ilgili kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
Zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme ve külün üstünün toprakla kapanması çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; farklı örnekler bu işlemin nesne, giysi, silah, kül ve gök görünümü üzerindeki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin üstünü başka bir şeyle kapatıp görünmesini engelleyen genel çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtme işlemini ve görünürlüğün engellenmesi sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zırhın giysiyle veya külün toprakla kaplanması gibi somut bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Somut bir nesnenin üstünün kapatılması işlemini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güneş ışığının yıldızları görünmez kıldığı göksel bağlamda sonuç odaklı doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Görsel örtmenin görünürlüğü ortadan kaldıran sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal zırh, silah, kül ve güneş ışığı gibi belirli gerçekleşmeleri de taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal haber veya tanıklığı gizleme ve örtü adı gibi daha geniş kullanımlara da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeğinde bir şeyi örterek görünmesini engelleme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak komşu dal soyut gizlemeyi ve örtü nesnelerini de kapsarken bu dalın kanıtı belirli somut ve görsel gerçekleşmelere dayanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel örtme dalı en yakın karışma olasılığını taşıdığı için yayımlandı, öteki adaylar yalnızca örnek veya ortak senaryo düzeyinde kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ستر الشيء وتغطيته وكفر الدرع بثوب وتغطية السلاح والرماد المكفور وستر الشمس النجوم والسحاب الشمس
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكفر الديني ولا كفران النعمة ولا الكفارة ولا الزراعة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الستر والتغطية (maqayis)؛ كل شيء غطى شيئا فقد كفره (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ كفرت الشيء أي سترته ورماد مكفور (sihah)؛ تكفر في السلاح (mufradat)؛ كفرت الشمس النجوم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karanlık geceyi, denizi, büyük ırmağı, gün batımını ve bulutu aynı adlandırma çevresinde toplar; bunların tümünü tek bir gerçek 'kuşatan örtü' türü saymak yerine, karanlık, genişlik veya kapatma etkisiyle örten farklı varlıklar olarak anlamak gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel karanlık ya da genel su kütlesi değildir; kaynakta örtücü etkisiyle adlandırılan belirli varlıklarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal, kaynakta doğrudan adlandırılan gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulut kapsamıyla tanımlanır; yapıya özgü başka anlam eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Karanlığı, genişliği veya kapatma etkisi nedeniyle kişileri ya da görünümü örten karanlık gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı veya bulut için kullanılan bir nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Karanlık, genişlik ya da kapatma etkisiyle başka şeylerin görünmesini veya seçilmesini engelleyen varlık.
Gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulut kaynaklarda bu nitelemenin farklı gönderimleri olarak sıralanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı sözü karanlık gece, deniz ve büyük ırmak için verir; bazı aktarımlar gün batımını ve bulutu da örtücü etkileri nedeniyle bu listeye ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Farklı gönderimleri tek bir nesne türüne indirgemeden ortak örtücü etkiyi anlatmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karanlık ve genişlik yoluyla örtme ortaklığını, gönderim çeşitliliğiyle birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün karanlık geceyi nitelediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gecenin karanlığıyla kişileri ve görünümü örtmesi özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulut gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün deniz veya büyük ırmak için kullanıldığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Deniz ve büyük ırmak gönderimlerinin genişlik ve kuşatıcılık yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gece, gün batımı ve bulut gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: karanlık gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı veya bulut

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal karanlık geceyi, gün batımını ve bulutu da aynı örtücü nitelemeye dahil eder.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal suyun yükselmesi, dalma ve suyla kaplanma olaylarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Deniz ve büyük ırmak, genişlikleri ve örtücü etkileri bakımından iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli varlıklara verilen bir nitelemeyi anlatır; komşu dal ise çok suyun örtmesi ve suya gömülme süreçlerini merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal gece dışında deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulutu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca gece karanlığının gölge veya karanlık örtü oluşunu işler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Karanlık gecenin görüşü örtmesi iki dalda da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak gece örneğine rağmen bu dal çok gönderimli bir adlandırmadır; komşu dalın çekirdeği doğrudan gece karanlığıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; suyla örtme ve gece karanlığı adayları dalın iki temel gönderim alanını sınırlandırdığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر للليل المظلم والبحر والنهر العظيم ومغيب الشمس وما يستر بظلمته أو سعته
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأرض البعيدة ولا القرية ولا الجبل ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافر مغيب الشمس ويقال بل البحر والنهر العظيم كافر (maqayis)؛ الكافر الليل والبحر ومغيب الشمس والكافر النهر العظيم (ayn)؛ الكافر الليل المظلم والكافر البحر والنهر العظيم (sihah)؛ الليل كافر لأنه ستر بظلمته (tahdhib)؛ وصف الليل بالكافر لستره الأشخاص والكافر للسحاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı inancın karşıtı ve gerçeğin örtülmesi olarak tanımlar; birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği yadsıma ile inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma türlerini açıkça içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dinî gerçeği ve inancı reddetmeyle sınırlıdır; nimeti yadsıma veya yalnızca genel bir gerçeği inkâr etme bunun tamamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dinî reddetme çekirdeği korunur; kalben bilip söylememe, bilip kabul etmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille reddetme yapıya bağlı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: İnancı, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddederek dinî gerçeği örtmek ya da kabul etmemektir. Kaynaklar bunu inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük, ortak koşma ve yalanlama gibi türlere ayırır.

facets.statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
Kalben bilip sözle kabul etmeme, bilip boyun eğmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille inkâr etme farklı türlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı inancın karşıtı sayar ve gerçeği örtme düşüncesiyle açıklar; toplu aktarım çeşitli inkâr, direnme ve ikiyüzlülük biçimlerini de sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnancın karşıtı olan çekirdeği ve reddedilen dinî içeriği birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî gerçeği kabul etmeme çekirdeğini ve inanç karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dalın genel dinî karşıtlık bağlamında eylem olarak çevrilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnancı kabul etmeme ve ona karşı durma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bile bile yadsıma veya direnme türünün açıklandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi ile dışa vurulan ret arasındaki ayrımı korur.
error_profile.loses: İkiyüzlülük ve bütünüyle bilgisiz inkâr gibi öteki türleri dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kalben bildiği gerçeği diliyle kabul etmeme
gerçeği bildiği hâlde inatla kabul etmemek
gerçeği hem kalple hem dille inkâr etmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle dinî inancı ve gerçeği reddeder; ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma gibi türleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, doğruluğu bilinen herhangi bir şeyi inkâr etmeyi din alanıyla sınırlamadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bilinen bir gerçeği kabul etmeme iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın dinî kapsamı ve birden çok tutum türü vardır; komşu dal ise konusu ne olursa olsun bilgiye rağmen yadsımayı merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dinî gerçeği kabul etmemeyi ve reddetmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal haberi veya dinî gerçeği doğrulayıp kalben benimsemeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı kabul-ret ekseninde dinî veya doğrulanabilir içerikle ilişki kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri gerçeği reddetme, diğeri onu doğrulayıp benimseme yönündedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yadsıma en yakın anlam komşusu, inanma ise açık karşıt kutup olduğu için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفر نقيض الإيمان وجحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة والإنكار والجحود والمعاندة والنفاق والشرك والتكذيب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كفران النعمة وحده ولا البراءة ولا التكفير عن السيئات
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر ضد الإيمان سمى لأنه تغطية الحق (maqayis)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان والكفر أربعة أنحاء كفر الجحود وكفر المعاندة وكفر النفاق وكفر الإنكار (ayn)؛ الكفر ضد الإيمان (sihah)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان وكفر إنكار وكفر جحود وكفر معاندة وكفر نفاق وكفر هو شرك وكفر بكتاب الله ورسوله والتكذيب بالله (tahdhib)؛ أعظم الكفر جحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nimeti yadsımayı, onu örtmeyi ve gereği olan şükrü yerine getirmemeyi aynı çekirdekte birleştirir; dalın geçici çerçevesi bu koşulu doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesne özellikle nimettir ve belirleyici sonuç şükrün terkidir; genel dinî ret bu dala kendiliğinden girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nimeti yadsıma çekirdeği yalın ve türemiş kullanımlarda korunur; nimetle kurulan yapı ve aşırılık bildiren kişi nitelemesi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nimeti tanımamak, değerini örtmek veya onun gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemektir. Bu tutumda aşırı olan kişi de aynı anlam alanında nitelenir.

facets.statement: Bir nimeti yadsıma veya şükrünü yerine getirmeyerek değerini örtme.
Nimetleri sürekli ve aşırı biçimde yadsıyan kişi bu tutumun yoğunlaşmış taşıyıcısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nimeti yadsımayı şükrün karşıtı sayar; örtme açıklaması, nimetin gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemeyi bu karşıtlığın belirleyici davranışı yapar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nimeti tanımama ile ona şükretmeme çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Nimetin inkâr edilmesini ve şükrün terk edilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nimetin veya yapılan iyiliğin tanınmadığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan iyiliği tanımama ve karşılığında şükretmeme tutumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: nimeti yadsımak ve şükrünü yerine getirmemek
iyilikleri karşılıksız ve teşekkürsüz kalan cömert adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimetin yadsınmasını ve şükrünün terkini doğrudan çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nimet yanında dostluğu kesme, felaketleri sayıp nimetleri unutma ve yardımı esirgeme gibi tutumları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Nimeti tanımama ve ona şükretmeme iki dalda da merkezîdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal nankörlüğü daha geniş bir davranış kümesine yayar; bu dal doğrudan nimet ile şükür arasındaki ilişkiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimeti tanımamayı ve şükrünü terk etmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nimeti tanımayı, övmeyi ve şükrü sözle ya da davranışla göstermeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal nimetin tanınması ve karşılığının verilmesi eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri nimetin değerini örter ve şükrü bırakır; diğeri nimeti tanır ve şükrü gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; daha geniş nankörlük dalı yakın eş, şükür dalı ise doğrudan karşıt kutup olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كفر النعمة وكفرانها وجحودها وترك شكرها والكفور في كفران النعمة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكفر الديني عند الإطلاق ولا الكفارة ولا البراءة
branches.source_phrase_ar: كفران النعمة جحودها وسترها (maqayis)؛ الكفر نقيض الشكر كفر النعمة أي لم يشكرها (ayn)؛ الكفر أيضا جحود النعمة وهو ضد الشكر (sihah)؛ الكفر كفر النعمة وهو نقيض الشكر (tahdhib)؛ كفر النعمة وكفرانها سترها بترك أداء شكرها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün bir şeyden uzak olduğunu bildirme, onunla bağını reddetme ve ondan sıyrılma anlamında kullanılabildiğini açıkça söyler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir inancı yadsımak değil, belirli bir şeyle bağı reddedip ondan uzaklaşmaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca bir şeyden uzaklaşmayı bildiren bağlı yapıda korunur; yalın köke genel bir ayrılma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyle olan bağı reddetmek, ondan uzak olduğunu açıklamak ve sorumluluk ya da aidiyet bağından sıyrılmaktır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir şeyle bağı reddederek ondan uzaklaşma ve kendini onun dışında tutma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bağlı kullanımın bir şeyden uzak olduğunu ilan etme ve onunla ilişkiden sıyrılma anlamı taşıdığında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, görüş, eylem veya sorumlulukla ilişkiyi açıkça reddeden bağlı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağı reddetme ile o bağdan uzaklaşma işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aidiyet veya sorumluluk bağının reddedildiği bağlamlarda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aidiyet bağını reddetme ve kendini dışarıda konumlandırma sonucunu korur.
